12783.description: Some Sea Elves are so connected to the ebb and swell of the ocean that the water itself responds to their call. This magical steed was created by a renowned sea witch celebrating their sixth century on the waves.

12785.name: Mind-Shriven Mudcrab
12785.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "Justice for the Fallen."
12785.description: "As I looked into the cold, crustacean's eyes, it snapped through my net like sword to skin. It was then that I realized that they were the predator, and I was the prey."—Bikkus-Xu, Angler

12786.name: Root-Whisper Crested Dart Frog
12786.description: What it lacks in flight, it makes up for in fight! One lunge and its prey is paralyzed with poison, which gives it enough time to eat and hop away like a normal frog.

12787.name: War Veteran's Hunting Dog
12787.description: "I love hunting with my dogs, but I can't understand why they try to pull my boots off after each hunt. Maybe it's a quirk of the breed?"—Ushataga

12802.name: Law of Julianos Dwarven Spider
12802.description: "Dwemer design married to the unyielding logic of Julianos. One of my finest creations. The first of this design was personally delivered to my patron in Wayrest, along with a fabulous bottle of wine."—The personal notes of the Spidersmith

12804.name: Jerall Deserter's Tharriker
12804.description: War deserters that huddle for warmth around bitter campfires in the Jerall mountains found common cause with these wild tharrikers. The wild magic that created them allows for rapid adaptation to the snowy slopes of their new home.

12963.name: Timber Mammoth
12963.description: "Behold the mammoth. Bred among the majestic trees of Malabal Tor. Let its strength endow you with courage and its even-tempered persistence carry you safely. And let its beauty uplift your soul."—Overheard at the Baandari Trading Post

12964.name: Bust: Lord Hollowjack
12964.description: This is a standard house collectible.

12965.name: Barbas
12965.description: Barbas, Clavicus Vile's faithful companion, loves being a talking dog. Why he wants to stay with you is for him to know and you to never find out. After adding Barbas to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

12966.name: Narsis Dren
12966.description: Self-proclaimed expert adventurer and prolific author Narsis Dren needs some time away from his exploits to write his next thrilling book. After adding Narsis to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

12967.name: Trophy: Lord Hollowjack
12967.description: This is a standard house collectible.

12968.name: Scaleborn Wolf
12968.description: "Honestly , it was pleasure just to work with someone outside the House. Please give my warmest regards to Queen Khamira, and I will take her up on her offer of hospitality the next time I'm in Rimmen."—Magister Varkenel

12969.name: Scaleborn Senche-Raht
12969.description: "We've received the scavenged material and the specifications for the product line. This is all very doable, but will likely be somewhat expensive given the properties of draconic fleshweave."—Magister Varkenel

12970.name: Scaleborn Ram
12970.description: "I think it's a wonderful idea, and the time table is completely workable. You should see your friends in the Dragonguard astride these beasts within the year."—Magister Varkenel

12971.name: Scaleborn Bear
12971.description: "If you're looking for a suggestion for the fourth form, might I suggest something like a bear? I know these mighty beasts are not local to your region but it's proven a popular shape in other work I've done."—Magister Varkenel

12972.name: Stone-Nest Landloper
12972.description: "Some customs of Solstice's Stone-Nest tribe date back well beyond Duskfall. The magical processes they used to shape flesh as they do stone is lost to the modern villagers, but lives on in ancient designs."—Muzah-Tei, Stone-Nest Scribbles

12973.name: Kyne-Blessed Thundersnow Steed
12973.description: These mounts are consecrated when they're only colts, given over in a ceremony to the Storm Goddess. Their riders say you can feel a distant rumble of thunder with every stride.

12974.name: Coldharbour Death Hound
12974.hint: Acquired by completing the "Savior of Solstice" achievement.
12974.description: Molag Bal's domain is patrolled by vampiric hounds. Wrapped in the mists of Coldharbour, bones erupting from flesh, it strikes fear into the hearts of others, and sometimes the hearts of their riders as well.

12975.name: Gloam Senche
12975.description: A native of the Nocturnal's domain, Evergloam, these ghost cats are known to escape their bonds and roam Tamriel at will. They choose only the most fortunate (or most unfortunate) to serve as their masters, who need a strong hand at the reins.

12976.name: Twilight Kagouti Destroyer
12976.description: This beast's black, scarred hide shows it to be the victor of many battles. Its fierce eyes declare that it has only recently been domesticated. Ride at your own risk.

12977.name: Golden Nix-Ox Steed
12977.description: The gilded shells of these creatures glow in even the weakest ashfall sunlight. Golden nix-oxen are prized both by merchants seeking to display their prosperity and by worshipers of Akatosh for their beauty.

12978.name: Gloam Senche Cub
12978.description: "As I sat by the fire, I felt two little eyes glaring at me in the darkness. I left some meat at the edge of camp and was shocked when a ghostly senche came out and nibbled on it. Maybe Nocturnal answered my prayer."—Recovered journal of Felisa Moabenar

12979.name: Heart's Grief Welwa
12979.hint: Acquired by completing the "Worth the Pain" Achievement.
12979.description: War mounts created to patrol the far reaches of Coldharbour, these dread beasts have been unleashed on Tamriel. Their hearts are dark with malice, and they live only to witness the destruction of others.

12980.name: Solstice Flats Dovah-Fly
12980.description: Isolation from the rest of Tamriel for generations has caused the local dovah-fly population to develop bright, unusual colors. They seem to be a warning to predators, although the Solstice dovah-fly itself isn't poisonous.

12981.name: Navire Chicken
12981.description: "It may not look like much, but this chicken is lucky, I swear. It's always finding little snacks for me, like apples or an old loaf of bread. It's like it doesn't want me to be hungry. Isn't that nice?"—Farmer Quentyn

12982.name: Twilight Kagouti Hatchling
12982.description: Though unruly, Twilight Kagouti Hatchlings can make excellent hunters—if their unfocused energy can ever be harnessed. Many a training session has been unexpectedly ended when a hatchling caught scent of some small animal and disappeared into the bushes.

12983.name: Golden Shalk
12983.description: An Ashlander tale says that one in every thousand clutches of shalk eggs is specially blessed by the ancestors. The existence of golden shalks seems to support this belief, but no one has ever seen one hatch before.

12984.name: Honeybutter Dragon Frog
12984.description: "I demand a refund on this dragon frog, Nahafa! All it does is scorch my things, bite my fingers, and make rude noises when I have guests. When you said it was a 'honeybutter' variety, I thought it would be sweet!"—Overheard at the Sentinel market

12991.name: Dragonclash Living Armor Senche
12991.description: Forged beneath the hammer blows of master Nord smiths, this living armor provides both speed and warmth. Its overlapping plates move with a supple and tireless grace, fueled by the flames within.

12992.name: Akatosh Living Armor Senche
12992.hint: After acquiring other collectibles from the Akatosh vs. Alduin Crown Crate, you can claim this mount.
12992.description: "All hail Akatosh! Golden one! Most resplendent! Let your flames glow bright within this creation! Let it spread your light and lead all to wisdom. Let Akatosh's power live within this wondrous creature!"—Dedication Ceremony

12993.name: Alduin Living Armor Senche
12993.hint: After acquiring other collectibles from the Akatosh vs. Alduin Crown Crate, you can claim this mount.
12993.description: "All-praise to Ald! World-Eater! First of Dragons! Let there be fire in this creature's belly and rage in its visage! Let its fury be felt by those who oppose us! Let Alduin fuel the power of this beast!"—Dedication Ceremony

12994.name: Tenmar Magpie
12994.description: Brilliant hues mark this vibrant magpie, whose primary habitat lies within the Tenmar Forest. Locals sometimes train them to signal the location of fallen prey for easier retrieval.

12995.name: Lilmoth Crocodile Hatchling
12995.description: Many of these hatchlings come from western Murkmire. Raised by the Dead-Water tribe to appear strong and spark fear, some secretly find them cute to keep as pets.

13061.name: Evenfall Brekka
13061.description: A great dark-furred creature, this beast holds its head high as if a queen among the herd. Other brekkas follow in the wake of this confident leader even in the harshest of climates.

13062.name: Evenshade Brekka Calf
13062.description: Baby brekkas are known to be affectionate, but this one is especially clingy. It's always within arm's reach, never straying farther than its neck can reach. It seems to take comfort in its owner's presence.

13063.name: Siluruz, Realm Craftsmaster
13063.description: Fresh from their Daedric forge, Craftmaster Siluruz has the talent to see to the heart of the matter, and thereby reduce items to their components. They avoid Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds, as mortal conflict bores them in their search for pure creations.

13066.name: Terilorne, Dibellan Freetrader
13066.description: Terilorne is a footloose merchant who seeks to spread the joy and beauty of Dibella in her wake. She will not enter Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds, as the jarring vibrations of the conflicts there harshes her enjoyment of the world.

13089.name: Statuette: Yokudan War-Scholar
13089.description: Brilliant battlefield tacticians often became venerated heroes among the Yokudan warriors.

13090.name: Statuette: High Elf Mage
13090.description: "Some claim to know the provenance of this sleek piece of art, but they know nothing. Especially when it comes to how impressive your home would be with a replica in it!" —Zaidrashi, Merchant

13091.name: Painting: Lucent Citadel
13091.description: Shrouded in mystery, the Lucent Citadel gleams in the sand of Fargrave's wastelands.

13106.name: Alabaster Vvardvark
13106.description: With the popularity of the vvardvark on the rise, Telvanni magisters are constantly searching for that hit "next look." Just as steadfast as their colorful kin, these beasts make for playful companions as long as they remain mostly indoors.

13107.name: Dragonclash Tomeshell
13107.description: "It was a stunning tome. Gorgeously detailed and filled with tales of esoteric Nord mythology. Supple leather binding, gold leaf on the cover … and now it's host for a transliminal parasite!"—Cipher Volan

13108.name: Windhelm Snow Owl
13108.description: "The sound of snapped bones led me back to my trap. A snow owl was eating my kill! So bold, I wasn't even mad. The next day we began our training, and we've been together ever since."—A Mountain Tale by Tharyt the Trapper

13109.name: Ghostwhite Vvardvark
13109.description: The magisters of House Telvanni are constantly working to perfect their craft and make some coin. This pallid beast is a trendy fashion statement for the next time you turn up at the inn.

13110.name: Leafember Ursauk
13110.description: "The fury of the druids could not be sated. As sparks fell around me and the forest burned, it appeared from beyond a curtain of smoke. Marked by the destruction. But still loyal."—Y'ffelon eruption survivor's tale

13116.name: Trappers Peak Wolf Cub
13116.description: These striking wolves are native to Amenos, where their ululating howls echo through the forest. The cubs don't yet have their calls perfected, but that doesn't stop them from trying to make themselves heard.

13117.name: Trappers Peak Wolf
13117.description: You'll not find a more dedicated and loyal mount. They bond closely with their masters, as long as they are properly fed, cared for, and get frequent tummy rubs.

13263.name: Daenian Great Ram
13263.description: The great rams of the Daenian birch forests tend to be shy and skittish. Yet, if properly trained, they can be exquisite and powerful mounts.

13265.name: Duo-Dynamo Guardian Spider
13265.description: Constructed of refurbished Dwarven parts within a fully reconditioned housing, the Duo-Dynamo is the perfect mount for a comfortable, sharable ride.

13271.name: Za'ji
13271.description: Captain Za'ji of the Perfect Pounce sails the seas from Elsweyr to High Isle. Now, though, he hopes to bunk with you while his ship is being refit. After adding Za'ji to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

13274.name: Ruinous Bone Dragon
13274.description: It goes without saying that bone Dragons of this size don't naturally exist. The necromancer that crafted this construct must have done so with utmost care. Even at this scale, the Dragon exudes an intimidating energy.

13286.name: Solstice Sloth
13286.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "The Gift of Death" in Solstice.
13286.description: The sloths of Solstice have long been favored pets of Sunport residents, especially children. It's not uncommon for teachers to perform "sloth checks" to make sure enterprising students aren't attempting to use their bags to smuggle sloths into lessons.

13292.name: Plaguewater Swamp Skeever
13292.description: "The first time I saw this skeever at my doorstep, I praised Peryite. Then prostrated myself, as this steed warrants. I'd been called into the world from my cave hideaway. Now we share my Prince's blessings wherever we travel."—Plague Elder Anai No-Nose

13293.name: Dreadmare of a Thousand Truths
13293.description: "Servants who earn Vaermina's trust may be gifted this loyal dreadmare. Their first ride from Quagmire takes them on an eldritch path, as the hands of the beast painfully claw out every flaw along the way."—Excerpted from "Paths Through the Mire"

13468.name: Aswala Scorpion
13468.description: "If your horse spares a red-tailed scorpion from being crushed underfoot, the scorpion was sent by the First Serpent to share your camp. To keep it free from vermin."—From Grandee Yaghoub's writings

13469.name: Dreamharrow Wasp
13469.description: Quagmire wasps build nests with nightmares as wasps of Nirn build nests with pulp. Distressing. Yet, you may find having one around useful. Especially when a Daedric Prince seeks to disturb your dreamwalks.

13470.name: Anequina Ginger Cat
13470.description: This adorable ginger cat has more purrs than you can count. He longs to be out and about, whether it's on an adventure or watching you craft potential kitty toys.

13471.name: Pestilent Pony Guar
13471.description: A colorful little friend happy to follow you into even the most disease-ridden dens. Many find the smell off-putting? But this true soul of Peryite goes snout-first into pestilence with a grin.

13472.name: Mara's Glory Wolf Pup
13472.description: "When times are tough and compassion grows thin, Mother Mara graces us with her wolf pups to remind us to be kind. Not nice, mind you. Nice tries to talk away all the bad. Kind recognizes the bad and seeks to end it."—Acolyte Ylaine

13473.name: Swamp Skeever Pup
13473.description: "Of course our skeever mounts start out as pups! That gives us time to train them properly, as Peryite intends. Just try not to cuddle them to death, got it?"—Yamighu

13491.name: Statuette: Imperial Knight
13491.description: A miniature statue of an Imperial knight, standing proud and ready to serve.

13492.name: Statuette: Redguard Warrior
13492.description: A miniature statue of a Redguard warrior, often used within royal tombs.

13493.name: Painting: Shadowfen Mirescape
13493.description: "You may see a swamp. Ruins. Trees. Water. But I see life and endings. Death and beginnings. And most of all change. Learn from the Shadowfen as I do."—Juutenma, Shadowscale

13494.name: Trophy: Orpheon the Tactician
13494.description: Trophy taken from Orpheon the Tactician in honor of an Undaunted victory in Lep Seclusa.

13495.name: Bust: Orpheon the Tactician
13495.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Lep Seclusa.
13495.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Lep Seclusa.

13496.name: Trophy: Squall of Retribution
13496.description: Trophy taken from the Squall of Retribution in honor of an Undaunted victory in Exiled Redoubt.

13497.name: Bust: Squall of Retribution
13497.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Exiled Redoubt.
13497.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Exiled Redoubt.

13498.name: Plaguerot Dragon Imp
13498.description: Rimmen gossips speculate this imp takes the shape of a miniature green Dragon in praise to Peryite, who helped the little beasts escape flu-ridden Orcrest.

13499.name: Soul Gem Senche Cub
13499.description: "This cub represents a strange mix of danger and comfort. I don't think this morpholithic cub can capture souls? But one never knows until one tries."—Afwa's Journal

13500.name: Pestilent Guar
13500.description: "The colors! So bright. Thank Peryite, it doesn't breathe vile fumes. Well, unless you've fed it fungus. Then it has the foulest breath ever. So. Don't feed it fungus."—Yamighu's New-New Journal

13501.name: Soul Gem Senche
13501.description: This beast serves its rider without hesitation. Necromancers claim it hums in dark resonance when near soul gems that were created in Coldharbour.

13504.name: Grimshadow Pillion Moose
13504.description: The inky-black fur of this moose blends into shadows during twilight treks a couple may wish to undertake in secrecy. Since the moose shares no gossip, your secrets remain safe.

13505.name: Wormwrithe Bear-Lizard
13505.description: "The guardians of the Writhing Wall were shaped, warped, and even twisted by the power of the souls contained within. We should care for the beasts and folk touched by the wall. What other choice do right-thinking folk have? "—Captain Meggrid

13506.name: Wormwrithe Haj Mota Hatchling
13506.hint: Acquired by completing the "Wormwrithe Haj Mota Hatchling" achievement.
13506.description: An odd creature first seen near the Writhing Wall, this hatchling exhibits a necromantic contamination that sets it beyond the natural order. It needs a good home, shunned by the other regional wildlife.

13517.name: Celia Tyde, Lost Fleet Bursar
13517.description:
Celia Tyde may be a pirate, but you can trust her to safeguard your valuables in the hold of her Lost Fleet vessel.

Aetheric winds mean you can't summon her in Cyrodiil or on Battlegrounds, though you and your groupmates can use her services.

13518.name: Voko, Carnaval Weapondancer
13518.description: You and your group can prep for sanguine slaughter by summoning Voko to change and save armory builds outside of your home. A lack of wine and dancing disinterests him from offering his services in Cyrodiil or the Battlegrounds.

13521.name: Elsbytte
13521.description: The Nord explorer Elsbytte and her faithful mammoth Muffins roam the wilds of Tamriel in search of adventure. Invite them to stay awhile! After adding them to your home, you can set them on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with Elsbytte.

13534.name: Ash-Tipped Durzog
13534.description: "A friend told me these durzogs came from a magical mishap with an extremely fortunate result. But they're so masterful, how can that be true? Either way, I love mine."—Dragonknight Ellean

13535.name: Blighted Sep Adder
13535.description: "What's worse than a surprise sep adder? A surprise sep adder blighted by Peryite. Unless? You tame it. Then you've got a friend for life sure to keep biting insects away. And, you don't need to follow Peryite to benefit."—Daixth

13537.name: Ash-Tipped Durzog Pup
13537.description: Born amidst High Isle's volcanic vents, this pup somehow looks both dangerous and cute. But don't let it lull you into complacency! It can burn through a slipper in two breaths if it gets too excited.

13538.name: Mind-Shriven Reef Viper
13538.description: Members of Legion Zero tuck their ophidian friends into a pack in anticipation of their dark blessing. Once they let the snake taste the Blood of Coldharbour, they create an undying mind-shriven companion.

13543.name: Mara's Glory Wolf
13543.description: Worshipers on pilgrimage in Mara's name may—rarely—wake to find one of her favored wolf steeds awaiting them. A not-so-gentle nudge from the Divine Mother.

13544.name: Nightmare Alchemy Vvardvark
13544.description: Fungal spores from the Telvanni Peninsula, when placed in a medium of Quagmire soil and mixed with Pits minerals, grow into a pungent slime. Both rider and beast, after imbibing, travel through a mix of the waking world and dream world.

13545.name: Nightmare Alchemy Senche
13545.description: Cult alchemists in Rimmen distill Tenmar plants watered from the Pits and grown in Dreamstride soil. A few drops from the resulting tincture for both rider and steed bless their missions for Peryite and Vaermina.

13546.name: Nightmare Alchemy Elk
13546.description: Cult priests form a compound with Blackwood herbs and bone salvaged from Quagmire and the Pits. The glowing solution guides this elk and its rider to Prince-favored destinations.

13547.name: Nightmare Alchemy Tharriker
13547.description: A mix of Skingrad wine, some ashy remnants of Quagmire dreams, and ooze from a Pits-born plague hopper make for a heady solution. After imbibing, neither rider or steed can waver from goals set by the Nightmare Queen and the Master of Tasks.

13549.name: Hollowsteel Construct Bear
13549.description: "When good Neramo proposed a line of constructs, Fazudah searched the face of the moons. Then inspiration struck. This one adores Orsinium metalwork! And we have sturdy Wrothgar steel blended with Elsweyri design! And who does not like a bear?"—Fazudah

13550.name: Hollowsteel Construct Wolf
13550.description: "This one would have preferred a senche, but good Neramo just loves the wolf. Still rather elegant she thinks, perfect for a beautiful ride through the countryside. Though Fazudah herself isn't much for riding. She prefers her studio."—Fazudah

13551.name: Hollowsteel Construct Indrik
13551.description: "We could have made anything, of course, but the indrik? Ahh, so sleek. Dreams and whimsy, made from metal! It looks cold, but good Neramo made it as loving as any real indrik. And you don't have to feed it."—Fazudah

13552.name: Duo-Dynamo Hollowsteel Spider
13552.description: "Good Neramo studied with the Spidersmith. So a many-legged multi-rider construct seemed a perfect choice: Dwarven chassis meets the design of mages and Khajiit, spun up in Orsinium steel. What would the Dwemer think if they could see it now?"—Fazudah

13554.name: Furnishing Vault
13554.description:
|cFFFFFF500 Slots|r

You can add the Furnishing Vault to multiple homes, plus retain access to stored items even if the vault isn't placed. Use either the placed vault or the Editor menu to retrieve, place, or store items. The vault holds furnishings only.

13555.name: Duchess Elea Dufort
13555.description: With her grand tour under way, Duchess Elea Dufort hopes to see more of the world beyond High Isle and the Systres Archipelago. Have her visit you! After adding Elea to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

13571.name: Painting: King's Haven Pass
13571.description: Stories claim High Elves and Goblins once traded peacefully at King's Haven Pass. After relations between the two soured, the Coral-Splitter Goblins claimed the area as their own.

13723.name: Bust: Overfiend Kazpian
13723.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Ossein Cage.
13723.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in the Ossein Cage.

13724.name: Trophy: Overfiend Kazpian
13724.description: Trophy taken from Overfiend Kazpian in honor of an Undaunted victory in the Ossein Cage.

13725.name: Sea Witch Weather Totem
13725.description: Place this furnishing in your home to call upon the weather magics of the Maormer. The skies above will stay as you wish until you use its power again. Homes without skies are not impacted by its spells.

13726.name: Hew's Bane Hyena
13726.description: When trained from a pup, these hyenas are sought-after battle mounts. Fiercely loyal to their riders, these relentless pursuers possess endless strength and endurance. Two or more together will form a pack and rile each other into a frenzy.

13739.name: Roseblood Bat
13739.description: "Drink deep of his gifts and be blessed for your devotion. For Sanguine cherishes all who embrace his revelry."—Swallow Thy Remedy and Find Peace

13741.name: Illusionist's Torchbug
13741.description: Fledgling mages are known to practice basic illusions on torchbugs, shifting the insect's natural color. In this case it appears someone was a little overzealous with their spellwork.

13742.name: Magmaflow Vvardvark
13742.description: Pulsing with heat, this vvardvark is ideal for the Dark Elf scholar who doesn't mind an occasional burn. Its molten skin allows it to traverse the Ashlands with ease, while its whip-like tongue singes and cooks insects as soon as it catches them.

13743.name: Chalk-White Brekka Calf
13743.description: Though its pale coloring makes this brekka calf look fragile, it's anything but. These small creatures boldly venture away from the herd to confront everything from ash hoppers to desert lions with the same dauntless bravery.

13744.name: Dragonstar Fawn
13744.description: Their affectionate demeanor and sweet tooth make them easy to tame, however they've been known to root up gardens in search of berries and fruit to snack on.

13745.name: Port Telvannis Bantam Guar
13745.description: These furtive bantam guar are particularly skittish. Their mottled coloring helps them blend in with the foliage of Port Telvannis, though their eyes sometimes give them away. They're experts at avoiding predators and would-be pet owners with ease.

13746.name: Honorfeather Fledgling Gryphon
13746.description: "This one had never designed a beast before! But Magister Varkenel was so kind! And Fazudah is quite pleased with how the colors turned out! They are so cuddly, and yet so dangerous. I am obsessed!"—Fazudah, Elsweyr

13747.name: Hew's Bane Hyena Cub
13747.description: The hyenas of Hew's Bane are fiercely loyal and violently territorial, so the taming process must start early. When properly imprinted on their owners, the cubs are eager to please and positively affectionate, though they often nip when overexcited.

13748.name: Chalk-White Brekka
13748.description: Bred to handle high heat and arid environments with ease. Their pale coloring keeps them cool, and wasteland travelers say they need far less water than their pigmented counterparts.

13749.name: Isle of Contemplation Indrik
13749.description: All indriks are ethereal, but this one brings with it a warm breeze and the smell of fresh blossoms. Something about being in its presence makes one want to lie down and doze in the sun, or find a stream in which to swim.

13750.name: Dragonstar Elk
13750.description: From the time they're born, these elk have a strong sweet tooth. This is at odds with their imposing antlers and intimidating appearance, but the Orcs of the Dragontail Mountains use it to their advantage, easily training them with treats and food.

13751.name: Redoran Foyada Vvardvark
13751.description: "It's a warm ride, that's for sure. Don't worry though, the skin isn't actually molten, just very, very hot. The tongue though. Watch out for the tongue."—Mondran Redoran, Ebonheart

13752.name: Forgefire Blade Lion
13752.description: "The result from a decade of collaboration between a forgemaster and a master of Daedric summoning.  A beast of sharp edges, molten veins, daggers for claws and knives for teeth. My life's work."—Forgemaster Gordronak

13756.name: Moonstone Bear Cub
13756.description: "Why wouldn't I turn inanimate moonstone into a cuddly pet construct you can use to light up your library at night? What exactly did you become a mage to do?"—Ohhendel, Sunport Mages Guild

13760.name: Dread Father's Goat
13760.description: "First Creator, Final Destroyer. Void embrace the fallen and felled. Void devour the banished and judged. Void become me so that I may serve your will."—Death-Dancer Recitation

13761.name: Pridehome Jerboa
13761.description: Though all jerboa are fast, these are particularly agile, making them a nightmare to keep track of. Luckily, they have a strong nesting instinct that guides them back home, no matter how far they run.

13762.name: Khenarthi's Thunder Pony
13762.description: "It's a good pet, no? Khenarthi has blessed it with her power, as you can see. Why bless a pony and not a senche? She works in mysterious ways. Just mind the static when you pet it. It gets zappy."—Shikruz, merchant

13763.name: Moonstone Bear
13763.description: This construct's stony body gives it endurance over long rides but, more importantly, the moonstone from which it's constructed is useful for spells. And this bear is more than willing to help.

13789.name: Painting: 10-Year Anniversary
13789.description: So many faces. So many stories. Relive a decade of adventures by picking out your favorite friends from this convivial painting.

13800.name: Trophy: Bar-Sakka
13800.description: Trophy taken from Bar-Sakka in honor of an Undaunted victory in Naj-Caldeesh.

13801.name: Bust: Bar-Sakka
13801.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Veteran Naj-Caldeesh.

13802.name: Trophy: Black Gem Monstrosity
13802.hint: Awarded for completing Black Gem Foundry.
13802.description: Trophy taken from the Black Gem Monstrosity in honor of an Undaunted victory in Black Gem Foundry.

13803.name: Bust: Black Gem Monstrosity
13803.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Black Gem Foundry.
13803.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Veteran Black Gem Foundry.

13804.name: Statuette: Nereid, Water Singer
13804.description: A miniature statue of a Nereid Water Singer, alight with power.

13805.name: Statuette: Molag Bal, Torturer
13805.description: A miniature statue of the Daedric Prince Molag Bal, Dark Lord of Torture.

13806.name: Painting: Carapace Caverns
13806.description: A painting representing Carapace Caverns, a bismuth-veined cave now plagued by an ancient undead curse.

13824.name: Khenarthi's Thundersteed
13824.description: Swift as the wind, with hoofbeats like thunder and the crackle of lightning in its mane, this strange beast will always be in the eye of the storm with you.

13825.name: Warrior Wave Badger-Bear
13825.description: "No pity or mercy shall be afforded the wretch who stands against the Warrior Wave."—Plea for Open Eyes

13826.name: Khefrem Spotted Eagle
13826.description: "I don't know how we would've made it through the desert without Azeta. Her sharp eyes and strong wings led us to prey we never knew was there. We followed her cries to a hidden water source that saved our lives."—Journal of hunter Bazdif, Hammerfell

13828.name: Pinnacle of Honor Quasigriff
13828.description: "It was a pleasure to partner with the incomparable Fazudah on beast concepts. The bold choices, the incredible colors. And as she says, I'm confident these creatures will cause a stir wherever they go—the best part of traveling!"—Magister Varkenel

13829.name: Warrior Wave Antelope
13829.description: "Honor your ancestors. He who permits their words and deeds to languish breaks his own blade and casts it to the burning wind."—Plea for Open Eyes

13830.name: Warrior Wave Senche-Cheetah
13830.description: "Take up the sword. Draw strength from the ancestors. Forge yourself in the fire of righteousness and you too will be sharpened with true honor."—The Unveiled Azadiyeh

13831.name: Warrior Wave Fennec Fox
13831.description: "The words of our fathers' fathers cry out for sweet water, but the legends they once carried crumble to dust. If we do not tend to them, we know that a new Ending Time, worse again than those before, draws near."—Plea for Open Eyes

13833.name: Glinting Talon Quasigriff
13833.description: "The bird-beast serves Tava in all things. Stand with it in battle and add its strength to your song. By talon and beak, at dawn and dusk, it cries in harmony with its singer."—An inscription found near the Battle of Six Hands

13835.name: Celestial Warrior Ornaug
13835.description: Tales of the Warrior charging through the night bring a sense of peace to those gathered on storm-sodden evenings.

13867.name: Na-Totambu War Elephant
13867.description: Forged by the talented hands of Crown-trained armorers. They turn metals cleaved from Hammerfell earth and worked in local forges into durable protection for this well-trained elephant. Better to be on this warbeast than in front of it.

13884.name: Eminent Slothcerer
13884.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "The Final Dark" in Solstice.
13884.description: "I'm telling you, it's magic. Really! The hat isn't just for show. Don't look at me that way. Show some respect. It could turn you into a toad for that. It would just take a while, that's all."—Ohhendel, Sunport Mages Guild

13885.name: Warrior Wave Painted Camel
13885.description: "Give your obedience to none save the gods of Yokuda. The Far Shores recede from he who leans upon thin-blooded shoulders, scornful of his feeble grasp."—Plea for Open Eyes

13887.name: Diamondscale Ornaug
13887.description: These colorful beasts split their time between sunning on rocks and cooling in tidal pools. Watching one scratch its back may just make your day! And be prepared to provide scritches if you choose to take care of one.

13890.name: Na-Totambu Pocket Elephant
13890.description: Once used by war smiths to test designs for their larger cousins, these tiny beasts have a gentle temperaments and make for favored pets. To this day, diminutive battle sigils mark them as beloved family members.

13891.name: Wildburn Boar
13891.description: Found by a pig farmer outside Skingrad, this burning beast was rooting around in her troughs. The boar, though clearly affected by the Wildburn, just wants what we all want: a full belly and a warm bed.

13892.name: Azurian Moth
13892.description: "Sail the waters of the Azurian Sea long enough and you're bound to see the migration of the water-moths. That's where I got this fellow. It had a weak wing and landed on my ship, so I took care of it. Now, it refuses to leave me."—Navigator Stacia

13893.name: Celestial Warrior Senche Cub
13893.description: Those dealing with night terrors may find the soothing purr of this Celestial cub chases away such sleep interruptions. Perhaps the Warrior protects their slumbers?

13894.name: Whale Shark Pangrit Nymphling
13894.description: "I believe Stuhn blesses our nymphlings. After all, they are near my home. And that means I can swim with them in the mornings. They like to nibble at my toes. That took some getting used to."—Orthald of Shor's Stand

13895.name: Glinting Talon Fledgling Gryphon
13895.description: "Grant the bird-beast's young succor in the name of Tava and Diagna. Strengthen it each day so that it may lend its song to yours."—An inscription found near the Battle of Six Hands

13896.name: Wildburn Tharriker
13896.description: "Never thought I'd say this, but one good thing came out of the Wildburn. This tharriker. Look at it. Nothing's gonna bother you when you're on it. Just mind the tail, now."—Stablemaster Marcus Buca

13897.name: Duo-Dynamo Dungeon Delver Spider
13897.hint: Acquired in the Season Zero: Dawn and Dusk Tome.
13897.description:
"You sure you have control over this one, Raynor?"
"I assure you, dear sister, that—oh er hmm. Just let me …"
"Let you what? And why is it blinking like that? Is it angry?"
"There! Can you … oh, you're already on it."
"Not by choice!"

13899.name: Whale Shark War Pangrit
13899.description: After a drunken wrestling match near Shor's Stand became a hug-the-pangrit contest, several Nords trained these curiosity-driven creatures to the saddle. Now they happily wander Solstice and beyond, trying out new tasty treats from their doting riders.

13901.name: Dungeon Delver Theodolite
13901.hint: Acquired in the Season Zero: Dawn and Dusk Tome.
13901.description:
"And what's this one do, Raynor?"
"I've made some decorative tweaks. But I'm not done yet."
"My question remains."
"Again, Kireth, I'm not done. But for now, it follows you."
"It doesn't explode randomly?"
"Of course not!"
"You said that last time, too."

13902.name: Kiss of Sithis Spider
13902.description: According to Alik'r assassins, the hidey holes these spiders lurk in are somehow favored by Sithis. By feeding one and luring it back to your lodging, Sithis can watch over you too.

13903.name: Daredevil's Dapper Cub
13903.description: "Would you believe this little furball snuck past every trap in a Dwemer ruin to find me? She tracked me for two days. Dafty me forgot to leave her treats with her minder. So now this little one comes with me on every adventure."—Memoirs of a Daredevil

13904.name: Daredevil's Dapper Lion
13904.description: "Do I take my fate into my own hands merely by riding this beast? Indubitably, yes. But just as it's in the lion's nature to strike at that which threatens it, it is in mine to brave danger while riding upon it."—Memoirs of a Daredevil

13905.name: Keel-Sakka Crocodile Hatchling
13905.description: The Tum-Taleel along the Keel-Sakka River occasionally train crocodiles to help them gather tribute from those crossing the river's bridge. Currently, they have no trained crocodiles due to reasons they prefer not to explain. Their loss, your opportunity!

13906.name: Sapphire Fledgling Terror Bird
13906.description: "Pluck a feather from a blue terror bird, and this one will buy a round of drinks for all! No, Turami, fledgling feathers do not count."—Nirshala

13907.name: Gem-Bellied Sep Adder
13907.description: A Hammerfell tale says that if you follow one of these gem-bellied creatures from dawn to dusk, it will go to ground near a hidden source of water. Where it vanishes into the earth, dig, and you'll find enough water for days.

13908.name: Krona-Konu Danger Frog
13908.description: "Look, if you call a critter 'danger frog,'  it's either deadly poisonous or the locals are yanking your tusks. With these little hoppers, both are true. Don't ask me how I know."—Shurithikh

13909.name: Broken Light Hermit Crab
13909.description: A bedtime story on Solstice tells of how the hermit crabs living around Broken Light Temple used to be a brilliant white. When Meridia's blessing shattered, these creatures also lost their light and have remained midnight-dark ever since.

13910.name: Thorn's Bite Withersteed
13910.description: Wind whispers through brittle leaves. The heady scent of roses sweeps over you. What comes? Will it be friend or foe? Does it bring pain or pleasure? Do these labels even matter when it comes to your—and Sanguine's—desires?

13911.name: Abecean Ship Rat
13911.description: Superstitious sailors along Abecean trade routes like to keep one caged light-furred rat aboard, claiming it knows when pirates draw near.

13913.name: Riften Rat Tracker
13913.description: When Riften's rat problem caused grain shortages years ago, merchants brought these skilled hunters in. Shortly after, the problem became piles of dead rats gifted to their favorite people, but all agreed that's a small price to pay for rodent control.

14018.name: Pontius Remus, Lupine Scavenger
14018.description: Pontius made a name for himself getting soldiers to safety when Imperial City fell to the Daedra. Now this survivor has a knack for turning old gear into useful crafting materials. Still, bad memories keep him away from Cyrodiil and the Battlegrounds.

14070.name: Statuette: Roaring Cathay-Raht
14070.description: A miniature statue of a Cathay-Raht roaring at foes.

14071.name: Statuette: Boethiah, Schemer
14071.description: A miniature statue of Boethiah, the Daedric Prince of Cruelty and Torture.

14072.name: Painting: Sunport Approach
14072.description: A painting of Sunport, the capital city of the balmy island of Solstice.

14120.name: Statuette: Defending Tojay-Raht
14120.description: A miniature statue of a well-trained Tojay-Raht, who guards against all foes.

14121.name: Statuette: St. Olms the Just
14121.description: A miniature statue of St. Olms, the Dark Elf patron saint of House Indoril.

14122.name: Painting: Lair of Maarselok
14122.description: "Every moment you hesitate, my influence creeps farther."—Maarselok

14197.name: Egg of Arac Replica
14197.description: A facsimile created to honor the living spider mounted on a gauntlet which allowed its user to grapple their way through the Skittering Precinct.

14198.name: Gleaming Lamp Replica
14198.description: A recreation of the powerful Gleaming Lamp. While the original is capable of casting enough light to keep the hungering Baleful Darkness at bay, this lamp is perfect for chasing the shadows out of dimly lit corners.

14199.name: Windglass Replica
14199.description: The Windglass keeps the sandstorms and cascading walls of sand from buffeting adventurers about in the Parch, but in the safety of their own home a replica is more than sufficient

14283.name: Winterhold Empyrean Wolf, Dusk
14283.hint: Acquired in the Season Zero: Dawn and Dusk Tome.
14283.description: The dusk variant of the Winterhold Empyrean Wolf.

14284.name: Winterhold Empyrean Wolf, Dawn
14284.hint: Acquired in the Season Zero: Dawn and Dusk Tome.
14284.description: The dawn variant of the Winterhold Empyrean Wolf.

14358.name: Trophy: Alziriix
14358.hint: Awarded for defeating Gilded Alziriix in the Gossamer Crypt.
14358.description: Trophy taken from Gilded Alziriix in the Gossamer Crypt.

14359.name: Bust: Alziriix
14359.hint: Awarded for defeating Gilded Alziriix in the Gossamer Crypt after completing the "Gold-plated Keymaster" achievement.
14359.description: Bronze bust of Gilded Alziriix in the Gossamer Crypt.

14360.name: Trophy: B'Kyfxi
14360.hint: Awarded for defeating Gilded B'Kyfxi in the Timeless Wallow.
14360.description: Trophy taken from Gilded B'Kyfxi in the Timeless Wallow.

14361.name: Bust: B'Kyfxi

14361.description: Bronze bust of Gilded B'Kyfxi in the Timeless Wallow.

14362.name: Trophy: Fateline's Knell
14362.hint: Awarded for defeating Gilded Fateline's Knell in the Mournful Catacomb.
14362.description: Trophy taken from Gilded Fateline's Knell in the Mournful Catacomb.

14363.name: Bust: Fateline's Knell
14363.hint: Awarded for defeating Gilded Fateline's Knell in the Mournful Catacomb after completing the "Gold-plated Keymaster" achievement.
14363.description: Bronze bust of Gilded Fateline's Knell in the Mournful Catacomb.

14364.hint: Awarded for defeating the Web Eater in the Opulent Ordeal.
14364.description: Trophy taken from the Opulent Web Eater in the Opulent Ordeal.

14365.description: Bronze bust of the Opulent Web Eater in the Opulent Ordeal.

119823.name: Tanzelwil Culanda Stone
119823.description: The bright golden light of this crystal has illuminated the honored tombs at Tanzelwil for generations.

119824.name: Veiled Crystal
119824.description: Though the sealing magic this crystal once held is broken, it still emits a soft light.

119825.name: Mehrunes Dagon Brazier
119825.description: This brazier once held a Sigil Stone capable of maintaining a gate to the Deadlands.

119826.name: High Elf Throne
119826.description: Queen Ayrenn favors a simple, elegant throne of marble and gold, a style that has become popular among her supporters.

119827.name: Ancient High Elf Statue
119827.description: The High Elves maintain these statues represent their honored ancestors, though some scholars insist they're of Ayleid design.

119828.name: Ayleid Throne
119828.description: Based on a design favored by Laloriaran Dynar, last king of the Ayleids.

119829.name: Shackle Control Stone
119829.description: Crafted from ebony-alloy cold-iron in Coldharbour's Black Forge.

119830.name: Coldharbour Chandelier
119830.description: The cold blue light from this pillar of crystal has illuminated cruelties beyond measure.

119831.name: Cowering Statue
119831.description: An effigy representing all those who recoil in fear before the cruel domination of Molag Bal.

119832.name: Light of Meridia
119832.description: A shining remembrance of the broad spectrum of heroes who fight for Meridia.

119833.name: Molag Bal Banner
119833.description: A banner brought back in triumph from the heroic challenges of Coldharbour.

119834.name: Aulus's Captive Audience
119834.description: It's comforting to know that at least one person will stick around until the end of your speech.

119835.name: Ukaezai's Ward
119835.description: With any luck, this petrified Ayleid never even felt the loss of his arm.  Or his head.

119836.name: Guardian Mane
119836.description: Normally found protecting holy sites of the Khajiit, this guardian statue was excavated from the Falinesti Winter Site—lending new credence to the legends of Rajhin's activity in the area.

119837.name: Orrery Control Pillar Replica
119837.description: Daraneth crafted several such replicas as part of her studies on the Osseous Orrery.

119838.name: Valenwood Brazier
119838.description: An eternal fire commemorating heroic achievements on the behalf of the citizens of Grahtwood.

119839.name: Fires of the Wilderking
119839.description: The ancient legend of the Wilderking turned out to be the living truth of modern Greenshade.

119840.name: Sea Elf Banner
119840.description: A banner originally taken as a trophy, following the defeat of the invading Maormer at Seaside Sanctuary.

119841.name: Hectahame Arboretum Relic
119841.description: This human skull emits a peculiar light, reminiscent of the night sky.

119842.name: Wood Elf Path Marker
119842.description: The Wood Elves could find their way through Valenwood blindfolded—these markers are instead for their guests, who may not find the forests so welcoming.

119843.name: Wood Orc Dream Catcher
119843.description: It's well documented that Wood Orc shamans collect dreams, but what they do with them is a closely guarded secret.

119844.name: Wood Orc Malacath Banner
119844.description: Like their cousins in northern Tamriel, most Wood Orcs honor Malacath.

119845.name: Wood Elf Union Trellis
119845.description: One tree may bend or break in the storm, but two together can support each other through any weather.

119846.name: Handfast Pedestal
119846.description: An altar for solemnizing the sacred marriage vows of the Wood Elves.

119847.name: Handfast
119847.description: A memorial for the heroic resolution of the Bosmeri existential crisis in Malabal Tor.

119848.name: Colovian Projection Crystal
119848.description: This crystal emits a gentle violet glow, even while separated from the rest of the projection apparatus.

119849.name: Moonmont Lunar Altar
119849.description: Attuned to the light of the two moons, this shrine can be refocused to several different lunar phases.

119850.name: Khajiiti Shrine Guardian Statue
119850.description: These stylized senche-cats can be found watching over shrines throughout Reaper's March.

119851.name: Waxing Moons Wall Tile
119851.description: Depicts Jone and Jode, both in the waxing phase.

119852.name: Waning Moons Tile
119852.description: Depicts Jone and Jode, both in the waning phase.

119853.name: Full Moons Tile
119853.description: Depicts Jone and Jode, both full and bright.

119854.name: New Moons Tile
119854.description: Depicts Jone and Jode, both new and dark.

119855.name: Wyrdstone
119855.description: Marks an area that is under the protection of the Beldama Wyrd.

119856.name: Torn Lion Guard Banner
119856.description: The Lion Guard are at their strongest with their backs against a wall.

119857.name: Breton Gravewatcher Statue
119857.description: These enormous statues were originally commisioned to watch over the dead in Cath Bedraud.

119858.name: Bloodthorn Vines, Small
119858.description: These vines show no sign of further growth, but their gentle movement still disquiets.

119862.name: Hagraven Totem
119862.description: Folk legends claim that if you camp in the Hag Fens, you will awaken to find yourself rooted in place, your body slowly twisting into the form of a withered tree.

119863.name: Knights of the Flame Banner
119863.description: A banner representing the noble knightly order of Alcaire in High Rock.

119864.name: Spirit Warden Azura Statue
119864.description: A replica of the celebrated statue of Azura in Pariah Abbey.

119865.name: Wayrest Guillotine
119865.description: Nightmares about guillotines are remarkably common in Wayrest.

119866.name: Replica Dreamshard
119866.description: Witnesses confirm that this replica is faithful to the original appearance of the mystical object.

119867.name: Vaermina Statue
119867.description: Originally commisioned by a noble to give a face to the nightmares that plagued him night after a night. It didn't help.

119868.name: Constellation Tile: The Ritual
119868.description: Recovered from ruins in the Doomcrag, this tile depicts the constellation of The Ritual.

119869.name: Constellation Tile: The Shadow
119869.description: Recovered from ruins in the Doomcrag, this tile depicts the constellation of The Shadow.

119870.name: Constellation Tile: The Tower
119870.description: Recovered from ruins in the Doomcrag, this tile depicts the constellation of The Tower.

119871.name: Wagon of Death
119871.description: You're going to give these people an honest burial, right?

119872.name: Tamrith Coffin Lid
119872.description: It's said that the dead rise so often in Rivenspire that they put the handles on the insides of the coffin lids.

119873.name: Tamrith Coffin
119873.description: Make your bedroom a dead-room with a coffin from haunted Rivenspire.

119875.name: Gargoyle Statue
119875.description: Originally found in the vampire-infested ruins of Shadowfate Cavern, it has shown no sign of animating. Yet.

119876.name: Tu'whacca's Brazier
119876.description: Used in the worship of Tu'whacca, who guides the fallen to the Far Shores.

119877.name: Reconstructed Necromantic Focus
119877.description: This has an unsettling habit of spontaneously reconstructing itself when destroyed.

119878.name: Standing Ansei Statue
119878.description: The triumph of the Ansei will never be forgotten.

119879.name: Kneeling Ansei Statue
119879.description: The sacrifice of the Ansei will never be forgotten.

119880.name: Replica of Shattered Ansei Sword
119880.description: The remains of one of several decoys commisioned by King Fahara'jad.

119881.name: Glenmoril Wyrd Stone
119881.description: The prevailing theory is that the red pigment on these stones is derived from a rare crimson flower, and is not the "blood of trespassing children," as claimed by some in Evermore.

119882.name: Damaged Knight of St. Pelin Statue
119882.description: Damaged in Septima Tharn's assault on Bangkorai Garrison.

119883.name: Evermore Mourning Banner
119883.description: In Evermore, those who have lost a loved one display their mourning banner on a spear, to represent the wound in their heart.

119884.name: Ragged Imperial Banner
119884.description: One of the few relatively intact banners recovered following the Imperial occupation of Southern Bangkorai.

119885.name: Ceremonial Redguard Vessel
119885.description: This massive bowl is traditionally used as a brazier for rites honoring the fallen.

119887.name: Serien's Stand
119887.description: A remembrance of the last stand of the obstreperous General Serien.

119888.name: Lacquered Kwama Egg
119888.description: An exquisite painted trophy memorializing heroic triumphs in Stonefalls.

119889.name: Daedric Sconce
119889.description: An ominous light source pillaged from Oblivion.

119890.name: Blood Fountain
119890.description: A grim reminder that the victories in Stonefalls were not without a price.

119892.name: Remnant of Balreth
119892.description: A hunk of bone and char, left over from the defeat of Balreth.

119893.name: Mimic Hist Tree
119893.description: A convincing replica of one of the mystically-sentient trees revered by the Argonians.

119897.name: Argonian Egg
119897.description: A replica of an egg of the reptilian Argonians of Shadowfen.

119898.name: Replica Mnemic Egg
119898.description: Following attempts by the Aldmeri Dominion to capture the Mnemic Egg, several replicas were created to foil future attempts.

119899.name: Replica Stone Nest
119899.description: Traditionally, the dais that holds Mnemic Egg is referred to as its nest.

119900.name: Oblivion Stone
119900.description: A dark chunk of raw stone, branded with the Daedric sigil Khot.

119901.name: Lob's Challenge Horn
119901.description: Winding this horn in Giant country could have hazardous results.

119904.name: Standing Slab
119904.description: This menhir of the ancient Nords stands in solemn tribute to the hero of Eastmarch.

119905.name: Dragon Shrine Altar
119905.description: Long ago the ancient Nords worshiped living Dragons at altars like this one.

119906.name: Throne of the Skald-King
119906.description: A replica of the throne of High King Jorunn granted in gratitude for services to Eastmarch.

119907.name: Visage of the Skald
119907.description: A traditional trophy of high-ranking bards of Skyrim.

119908.name: Swamp Anemone
119908.description: A living trophy and constant reminder of the lush fungal foliage of Deshaan.

119910.name: Veloth's Reliquary
119910.description: Relish this replica reliquary for retaining relics of the revered Veloth.

119911.name: Tribunal Rug
119911.description: A circular rug, emblazoned with the bronze symbol of the Tribunal.

119913.name: Tribunal Altar
119913.description: Each side of this pillar represents one of the three members of the Tribunal: Almalexia, Sotha Sil, and Vivec.

119914.name: Touch of Plague
119914.description: A sealed container, believed to hold a sample of the Llodos plague.

119915.name: Ancient Cultist Totem
119915.description: Legend claims that the skulls beneath Fallowstone Vault hark back to the age of the Dragon Cult.

119916.name: Ysgramor Statue
119916.description: A statue honoring the Nord culture hero Ysgramor, "The Harbinger of us all."

119918.name: Statue of the Wolf
119918.description: A recreation of the statue that has sat outside Fallowstone Hall for longer than anyone can remember.

119920.name: Totem of the Reach
119920.description: This totem doesn't seem to carry the usual death curse. No one's died yet, at least.

119922.name: Torn Worm Cult Banner
119922.description: One of many trophies taken following the defeat of the Worm Cult in The Rift.

119923.name: Serpent Stone
119923.description: A Craglorn-style trophy awarded to commemorate victory in the Dragonstar Arena.

119925.name: Nirncrux Bowl
119925.description: The rare material Nirncrux is so prized by the miners of Craglorn that it is conveyed in special bowls.

119929.name: Snake Prayer Tile
119929.description: A holy symbol of the ancient Nedes denoting a location of worship.

119930.name: Totem of the Serpent
119930.description: A memorial commemorating the defeat of the Serpent Constellation's machinations in Craglorn.

119931.name: Craglorn Tapestry
119931.description: A reconstruction of the famous tapestry depicting the conflict of the Constellations.

119933.name: Craglorn Brazier
119933.description: A brazier originally used by one of the ancient and nigh-forgotten cultures of Craglorn.

119934.name: Craglorn Sconce
119934.description: A light source crafted in the style of the ancient Ra Gada conquerors of Craglorn.

119935.name: Observatory Banner
119935.description: This long banner depicts a stylized and ordered version of the sky, as observed by the Stargazers of Craglorn.

119936.name: Poisoned Blood
119936.description: This is a small house item.

119937.name: Gold Coast Estate Keg
119937.description: A keg of Anvil malmsey to mark the expert infiltration skills of a Dark Brotherhood initiate.

119938.name: Light and Shadow
119938.description: This is a small house item.

119939.name: Hourglass Rug
119939.description: A rug stolen from those officious knights of the Order of the Hour.

119940.name: Sanctuary Sconce
119940.description: This light source is a reminder of the tasteful and restrained décor of the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary.

119941.name: Brotherhood Poison Vial
119941.description: An ornamental copy of one of the Dark Brotherhood's bottled toxins.

119944.name: Order of the Hour Banner
119944.description: A banner "borrowed" from the Akatosh-worshiping knights of the Order of the Hour.

119945.name: Dark Brotherhood Banner
119945.description: This hanging banner announces one's membership in the Dark Brotherhood. Display it with caution.

119947.name: Banner of the Kvatch Guard
119947.description: The noble wolf's-head banner of the respected Kvatch Guard.

119948.name: Statue of the Mother
119948.description: No one would be so bold as to assert without contradiction that this is a statue representing the Night Mother.

119950.name: Preserved Sweetrolls
119950.description: A cluster of sweetrolls—a delicious trophy that commemorates thwarting the Sweetroll Killer of the Gold Coast.

119951.name: Litany of Blood
119951.description: A replica of the Dark Brotherhood's sinister tome of death.

119952.name: Sacrificial Heart
119952.description: This is a small house item.

119953.name: Dark Ledger
119953.description: Every Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary has a book that balances the costs of living against the wages of death.

119954.name: Reliquary Skull
119954.description: A replica of the Giovessen Skull, a relic whose history extends back nearly 600 years.

119955.name: Pale Garden Flowers
119955.description: These flowers are a reminder of how short and ephemeral a thief's life can be.

119960.name: Jar of Green Dye
119960.description: Enough concentrated green dye to make Hammerfell look like Valenwood.

119961.name: An Adoring Fan
119961.description: A souvenir of your visit to an exclusive Hew's Bane soiree.

119963.name: Yokudan Puzzle Column
119963.description: Puzzle locks based on rotating stone pillars have been used in vaults and labyrinths since time immemorial. This version hails from ancient Yokuda.

119965.name: Abah's Landing Banner
119965.description: The flag of the Free and Open Trading Port of Abah's Landing.

119966.name: Iron Wheel Banner
119966.description: The banner of those over-achieving law enforcers known as the Iron Wheel.

119967.name: Vibrant Garden Flowers
119967.description: The life of a desert flower is brief but bright, so the Redguards treasure them for their gardens.

119968.name: Distracting Harpy Egg
119968.description: "The hideous harpy, half-avian abomination, is shunned by all the faithful of Tava." —The Revered Mubdaraz

119969.name: Banner of Taneth
119969.description: The esteemed banner of the Kingdom of Taneth in Hammerfell.

119970.name: Redguard Round Table
119970.description: This is a standard house item.

119971.name: Statue of Shadows
119971.description: Though all are impressed by the grave solemnity of this statue, none can agree on whom it represents.

119974.name: Hiding Place
119974.description: A typical nondescript Abah's Landing basket. No one would ever think of looking in there!

119975.name: Orsinium Cart
119975.description: An Orcish wheeled cart: they build 'em sturdy in Wrothgar.

119976.name: Orc Adventuring Backpack
119976.description: This rugged and capacious backpack is a reminder not to venture unequipped into the wilds of Wrothgar.

119977.name: Orcish War Totem
119977.description: Orcs like to announce great events by erecting symbolic totems: this one heralds war.

119978.name: Orcish Battle Totem
119978.description: Orcs like to announce great events by erecting symbolic totems: this one foretells battle.

119979.name: Fur Throne
119979.description: If you were an Orc chieftain in frozen Wrothgar, you'd want furs on your throne, too.

119980.name: Orcish Totem
119980.description: Orcs like to announce events by erecting symbolic totems: this one marks territory.

119981.name: Throne of the Orc King
119981.description: A replica of the throne entitled by tradition to the Orc chief who unites the clans into a kingdom.

119982.name: Molag Bal Brazier
119982.description: This Coldharbour brazier commemorates the thwarting of Molag Bal's last-ditch attack on Nirn.

119983.name: Imperial Banner
119983.description: A banner earned for plumbing the labyrinth of sewers beneath the Imperical City.

119984.name: Pirate Banner
119984.description: Proudly fly the flag of Abecean piracy after recruiting freebooters for a daring venture.

119986.name: Maormer Totem
119986.description: A symbol of the perfidious Sea Elves of Pyandonea.

119987.name: Coldharbour Urn
119987.description: Replica of an urn as found in the Wailing Prison in Coldharbour. Because you always remember your first iron dagger.

119988.name: Replica Soul Gem
119988.description: A copy of one of the mysterious and mystical crystals used to capture the souls of dying entities.

119989.name: Replica Black Soul Gem
119989.description: An imitation of one of those sinister crystals used to entrap the souls of dying sentient beings.

119990.name: Soul Gem Case
119990.description: The sort of case sorcerers and necromancers use to keep their soul gems safe, clean, and shiny.

119991.name: Spare Flesh Atronach Parts
119991.description: Unlike most summoned Daedra, the Flesh Atronach requires some pre-assembly.

119992.name: Soul Gem Crate
119992.description: The sort of crate sorcerers and necromancers use to keep their soul gems safe, clean, and shiny.

119993.name: Lantern of Anguish
119993.description: The crimson light from this lantern complements either torture or seduction equally well.

119994.name: Depleted Sigil Stone
119994.description: A mystic runestone, now drained, once used to hold open an Oblivion gate.

119995.name: Silent Sentinel
119995.description: A solemn reminder of the heroic effort to challenge the schemes of Molag Bal.

119996.name: Soul Gem Stand
119996.description: Just the thing for displaying your cruel magical implement used to enslave creatures' souls.

119997.name: The Final Threat
119997.description: Molag Bal has had countless such statues erected in his name, and woe unto he who mocks their craftsmanship or artistry.

119999.name: Daedric Chest
119999.description: The heroism of dauntless slayers of Daedra is marked by presentation of a chest stolen from Oblivion.

120000.name: Broken Chain
120000.description: Links from the fallen chain of a shattered Dark Anchor.

120001.name: Decorative Treasure Chest
120001.description: Someone so relentlessly dedicated to the pursuit of treasure deserves such an ornamental coffer.

120002.name: Dueling Banner
120002.description: A banner representing a challenge to the death. Only a supremely confident duelist would decorate their home with such a thing.

120003.name: Cheese Cutter
120003.description: When the Mages Guild won away Eveyea from Sheogorath, the Madgod presented them with a supply of cheese cutters to award as guild prizes.

120005.name: Soul Gem, Common
120005.description: This is a small house item.

120008.name: Soul Gem, Lesser
120008.description: This is a small house item.

120011.name: Mages Guild Banner
120011.description: A banner presented to one who has more than earned the right to display Mages Guild affiliation.

120019.name: Fighters Guild Banner
120019.description: A banner presented to one who has more than earned the right to display Fighters Guild affiliation.

120023.name: Outlaw Banner
120023.description: A banner proudly displaying the covert three-bladed symbol of Tamriel's outlaws. (Wait, that's supposed to be secret!)

120025.name: Pile of Coins
120025.description: This replica treasure looks just like a real pile of coins, doesn't it?

120026.name: Mountain of Loot
120026.description: Never lack for a packed stack of black market fake drakes.

120027.name: Mass Tombstone
120027.description: A grim memorial to the staggering number of creatures you've massacred in cold blood.

120028.name: Death Marker
120028.description: Yeah, well, they probably had it coming.

120029.name: Noble Pocket Lint
120029.description: You've picked so many pockets, the ends of your fingers are chapped.

120030.name: Pocket Change
120030.description: So now you're a creeping, furtive sneak thief. Wouldn't your parents be so proud?

120031.name: Replica Key Blank
120031.description: Copy of an item perfect for creating illicit copies of a "borrowed" key, or for fashioning into a bump key.

120032.name: Decorative Thieves Trove
120032.description: Every time you looted one of these, you thought, "I wish I had one." And now you do.

120033.name: Decorative Safebox
120033.description: In the vicinity of such a master cracksman, it's possible that "safebox" is a bit of a misnomer.

120034.name: Undaunted Mug
120034.description: A ceremonial mug presented in the name of true Undaunted camaraderie!

120035.name: Undaunted Chest
120035.description: A handsome chest for all the loot collected on missions performed for the Undaunted.

120036.name: Undaunted Banner
120036.description: A banner presented to one who has more than earned the right to display affiliation with the Undaunted.

120037.name: Decorative Skyshard
120037.description: This mystic crystal commemorates the colossal achievement of finding skyshards all across Tamriel.

120038.name: Throne of Cyrodiil
120038.description: Even in the tumult of the Three Banners War, sitting atop the Ruby Throne is a rare and coveted privilege.

120039.name: Primal Altar to Hircine
120039.description: Display your feral devotion to the Father of Manbeasts with this rustic altar.

120040.name: Crimson-Stained Bowl
120040.description: Baron Montclair preferred to drink from a shallow bowl, claiming that it enhanced bouquet, while allowing just enough coagulation to give a pleasing texture on the tongue.

120043.name: Fishing Vessel
120043.description: Though a master fisher needs only bait and line, most own a small and steady sailboat for lazy Sundas excursions.

120044.name: Alchemist's Sign
120044.description: A sign with the symbol used by all those who can tell an alembic from a calcinator.

120045.name: Poison Satchel
120045.description: Poison-making is a skill abhorrent to most citizens of Tamriel, so keep this distinctive satchel a secret.

120046.name: Blacksmith's Sign
120046.description: A sign earned by one who's become a master of the forge and hammer.

120048.name: Clothier's Sign
120048.description: A sign earned by one who's become a master of the needle and scissors.

120050.name: Enchanter's Sign
120050.description: A sign earned by one who's become a master of Aspect, Essence, and Potency.

120051.name: Enchanting Gem
120051.description: A handsome gem awarded to all those who become Potentates of Potency!

120052.name: Provisioner's Sign
120052.description: A sign earned by one who's become a master of the cooking fire and spoons.

120053.name: Chef's Cleaver
120053.description: This is bound to be a useful utensil to one who knows such a quantity of recipes.

120054.name: Woodworker's Sign
120054.description: A sign earned by one who's become a master of the chisel and saw.

120056.name: Hanging Map of Tamriel
120056.description: A well-worn map, clearly used on many a Tamrielic journey.

120057.name: Harvester's Woodpile
120057.description: A symbolic pile of precious woods awarded to a master harvester of timber.

120058.name: Harvester's Herbs
120058.description: A symbolic bunch of precious plants awarded to a master harvester of herbs.

120059.name: Harvester's Ore
120059.description: A symbolic outcropping of precious raw metal awarded to a master harvester of ore.

120060.name: Harvester's Critter Trap
120060.description: A symbolic critter trap awarded to a master harvester of lesser creatures.

120061.name: Harvester's Garden Shrub
120061.description: A symbolic flowering shrub awarded to a master harvester of floral materials.

120062.name: Smith's Bellows
120062.description: A smith who's forged as much as you could probably work a smith's hammer with closed eyes. (But don't try it.)

120063.name: Dominion Hero Shield
120063.description: This crest is awarded only to the greatest heroes of the Aldmeri Dominion.

120064.name: Covenant Hero Shield
120064.description: This crest is awarded only to the greatest heroes of the Daggerfall Covenant.

120065.name: Pact Hero Shield
120065.description: This crest is awarded only to the greatest heroes of the Ebonheart Pact.

120066.name: Display Craft Bag
120066.description: Unlike a real Craft Bag, this display version can't hold impossible amounts of crafting materials.

120075.name: Decoy Elder Scroll
120075.description: At exceptional cost, a small number of decoy Elder Scroll cases were commisioned early in the Three Banners War. The enchantments can be adjusted to mimic either an offensive or defensive scroll.

120079.name: Disconnected Transitus Shrine
120079.description: Though no longer connected to the Transitus Shrine Network, this shrine still emanates power.

151777.name: Statue, Yolnahkriin
151777.description: With spread wings, the golden statue form of Yolnahkriin can preside over your home or garden, lending it the majestic presence of a Dragon.

151778.name: Statue, Lokkestiiz
151778.description: Perched on an hourglass, the silver statue form of Lokkestiiz can impress those who visit your home.

151779.name: Moon Gate
151779.description: Add a miniature version of a Moon Gate to your home. It's the perfect size for your favorite housecat! (Just don't try to use it. It's there to make an impression, not actually work!)

151780.name: Banner, Rimmen
151780.description: Show your support for Rimmen's independence from tyranny by hanging this colorful banner in your home.

151781.name: Banner, Anequina
151781.description: The arid northern region of Elsweyr, called Anequina, has bred hearty warriors and pragmatic thinkers, though some have learned to work the land. Show your respect for the traditions of Anequina by hanging this banner in your abode.

151782.name: Khajiit Burial Mound
151782.description: Khajiit of Anequina often build cairns of local stone to mark their dead. Perhaps you need such structures for your own land?

151783.name: Replica Dragon Horn, Large
151783.description: This replica of the Dragon Horn found in Anequina can lend a certain air of majesty to your home or landscape. You might find cats or even Alfiq making use of it as a comfy sleeping spot.

151784.name: Replica Dragon Horn, Small
151784.description: Have an alcove that needs a touch of ancient charm? This small Dragon Horn replica is perfection itself for just such a space!

151785.name: Wrathstone, Replica
151785.description: Rest assured, you won't be releasing Dragons into Tamriel by possessing this replica of the ill-used Wrathstone. (Just don't let Abnur Tharn see it—unless you like pouring salt into wounds.)

151786.name: Moon Temple Pad
151786.description: That floor that seems so empty? Add some color with this Moon Temple Pad. The rich blue adds serenity to any space.

151787.name: Khajiit Lion Crest
151787.description: This fierce fellow can make any bit of wall look more imposing. An excellent touch for those seeking a sense of dominance over others. As a bonus feature, you can activate him to become a wall torch!

151788.name: Khajiit Wagon, Ruined
151788.description: Are you a fan of fake ruins? Do you want to lend a lived-in look to your garden? This Khajiit wagon is a match for both of these décor choices.

151789.name: Khajiit Wagon, Merchant
151789.description: Due to an unfortunate mishap, it cannot be used to move goods, but it certainly sets the tone for the area.

151790.name: Akaviri Table, Stone
151790.description: This hefty Akaviri table can dominate a room or help pull together the stone elements in your landscape.

151791.name: Column, Fatal Warning
151791.description: Sometimes you need to mark an area as dangerous. Or maybe you just want to provide a gentle "please do not bother me" warning to those who would pester you. This column? Excellent for both such scenarios.

151792.name: Tojay-Raht Statue, Monk
151792.description: Want to bring the elegant solemnity of an adeptorium to your home or garden? This statue, with a Khajiit adept performing a kata, will do exactly that.

151796.name: Riverhold Defense Spikes, Piled
151796.description: Everyone needs these "go away, and I mean it" spikes. Everyone. (Especially those in Riverhold.)

151797.name: Riverhold Defense Spikes, Tripod
151797.description: Are your neighbors jumping over the wall of your yard and into your garden, disturbing your hard-won natural aesthetic? Just place this tripod where they normally land, and watch the result!

151798.name: Riverhold Defense Spikes, Roof-Mounted
151798.description: These roof-mounted spikes signal to those who see them that you are definitely planning to hold your home fast against any nuisances, including Dragons.

151799.name: Projection Stone, Moons
151799.description: Both shiny and colorful, this projection stone shows the phases of the moons. Perfect for your midnight garden or bedroom!

151800.name: Cage, Small Animal
151800.description: Whether it's skeevers or pebble pals, this small cage can hold the creature or thing of your choice.

151801.name: Barrel, Riverhold
151801.description: A barrel can contain many things, such as, say, skooma stashes. But you wouldn't have any skooma, now, would you?

151802.name: Crate, Riverhold
151802.description: You might think that a crate is utilitarian, but your housecats will prize it almost as much as they prize the sound of you adding food to their "empty" bowls.

156753.description: These replica bells might not "find things" as Za'ji says, but they lend a visual reminder of Khenarthi's grace to any location. May the winds favor you and yours.

156754.name: Dragonguard Sarcophagus
156754.description: The restoration of the Dragonguard and renovation of the sanctum led to a startling discovery: ancient sarcophagi containing the order's honored dead. Fearing future conflict on the island, Sai Sahan has placed these legendary warriors in your charge.

156755.name: Vine, Moonlit Cove
156755.description: The sacred waters of the Moonlit Cove lend their blessing to the glowing flora that grows within, or so the Khajiit claim.

156756.name: Khenarthic Bell
156756.description: Known for their cleansing properties, Khenarthic Bells abound in shrines and other places sacred to the Goddess of the Winds. This replica bell might not remove corruption, but its presence can remind onlookers to take a moment and breathe mindfully.

156757.name: New Moon Cult Banner, Large
156757.description: Promising much to vulnerable Khajiit, the Order of the New Moon provides a place for them to go. Yet, in halls strewn with banners such as these, many find more than they expect … or want.

156758.name: New Moon Cult Banner
156758.description: Promising much to vulnerable Khajiit, the Order of the New Moon provides a place for them to go. Yet, in halls strewn with banners such as these, many find more than they expect … or want.

156760.name: Painted Rock, Life's Glory
156760.description: With strokes of vibrant colors, a Black Heights artist rendered a vision of the richness of life before starting on the path to the Sands Behind the Stars.

156761.name: Painted Rock, Heart's Ease
156761.description: The dominating reds and yellows of this rock painted in the Black Heights style can enhance the visual appeal of your garden, plus provide you with a remembrance of those who came before you.

156762.name: Map of Southern Elsweyr, Hanging
156762.description: Also called Pellitine, Southern Elsweyr features a port city, several Khajiiti sacred places, an artist's retreat, locations of a scurrilous nature, an Imperial citadel, and plenty of stories both brilliant and dark.

156763.name: Senchal Banner
156763.description: The blue and gold Senchal banner features lunar symbolism, reflecting the Khajiit's cultural reverence for the moons Jone and Jode.

161208.name: Rune-Carved Mammoth Skull

161209.name: Nest of Shadows
161209.description: Deadly and dramatic, this metal serpent encircles, and some say threatens, the lavender-hued egg nestled in its coils.

161210.name: Prismatic Sunbird Feather
161210.description: Gloriously stunning doesn't even begin to describe this unusual feather. Allow it to light up a dark nook or perhaps place it front and center in your personal collection of eye-catching objects.

161211.name: Remnant of the False Tower

161212.name: Silvenari Sap-Stone

161213.name: Sorcerer-King's Blade

161214.name: Spellscar Shard
161214.description: This captivating shard of the great obelisk retains just enough energy to emit a dramatic fire and electrical show.

161215.name: Yokudan Skystone Scabbard

161216.name: Tri-Angled Truth Altar
